newsitem.title: USA: Syratech stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Syratech stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Wednesday it had cut its stake in Syratech Corp to 809,700 shares, or 9.33 percent, down from 10.38 percent previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included a net of 117,800 shares sold between October 23 and November 27 at prices ranging from $30.75 to $31.3240 per share.

Syratech, of East Boston, Mass., designs, manufactures, imports and markets a diverse portfolio of table top giftware and seasonal products, including silverplated and stainless steel flatware, picture frames, glassware, waterglobes, figurines, etc.
